services.name: Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Destin's most popular water adventure - 1 hour on the Gulf, searching for dolphins and soaking up the emerald coast. The HydroJet Dolphin Cruise is a 1-hour open-water adventure along Destin's stunning emerald coastline. You'll depart from 314 Harbor Blvd and head out into the Gulf, cruising past the famous Crab Island and scanning the water for dolphins and other marine life. The HydroJet is unlike any other boat in Destin - a custom-built vessel that combines the thrill of a jet-ski with the capacity of a tour boat.
